background_setup.summary: # Introduction Game glitches are unintended failures in gameplay, such as broken physics, rendering artifacts, animation errors, collision failures, or logic inconsistencies .

background_setup.summary: Detecting such glitches from gameplay videos is an important capability for game quality assurance (QA) , where testers typically examine gameplay sessions to inspect suspicious behaviors and summarize the issue with detailed bug reports.

evidence.quote: Detecting such glitches from gameplay videos is an important capability for game quality assurance (QA) [33], where testers typically examine gameplay sessions to inspect suspicious behaviors and summarize the issue with detailed bug reports.
